toegepas.voor: enigeen kan gaan kyk presies wat gevra is
toegepas.na: enigeen kan gaan kyk wat presies gevra is
toegepas.rede_vinder: In Afrikaans 'presies' stands inside the indirect question, after 'wat'.
toegepas.fout: 'kyk presies wat' copies English 'see exactly what'; Afrikaans puts 'presies' after the question word.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'wat presies gevra is' is the natural Afrikaans order and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Die kinders wou hê daardie eise moet die onderhandelinge oor 'n nuwe Grondwet bereik
toegepas.na: Die kinders wou hê dat daardie eise die onderhandelinge oor 'n nuwe Grondwet moet bereik
toegepas.rede_vinder: Written Afrikaans needs 'dat' after 'wou hê' with the verb at the end of the clause; the dropped 'dat' is spoken style.
toegepas.fout: Dropped 'dat' after 'wou he' with the verb mid-clause is spoken style in a written study text.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding 'dat' with the verb at the end is the correct written construction, same meaning.

toegepas.blok: Wat die kinders onder meer gevra het
toegepas.voor: van 'n nuwe reël dink en jy antwoord
toegepas.na: van 'n nuwe reël dink, en jy antwoord
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subject and verb ('Die onderwyser vra' / 'jy antwoord').
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required by AWS 2017 and changes nothing else.

toegepas.blok: Wat die handves nog verder sê
toegepas.rede_vinder: With 'geen ... nie' Afrikaans uses 'mag' for a prohibition; 'geen ... moet' echoes English 'no child should'.
toegepas.fout: 'Geen kind moet gedwing word' echoes English 'no child should be forced'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Geen kind mag gedwing word' is the natural Afrikaans way to state the charter's demand, and the demand stays the same.

toegepas.blok: Die handves en die Grondwet langs mekaar
toegepas.voor: is eerste sy gesin se plig
toegepas.na: is in die eerste plek sy gesin se plig
toegepas.rede_vinder: Bare 'eerste' reads wooden here; 'in die eerste plek' is the natural expression with the same meaning.
toegepas.fout: Bare 'is eerste sy gesin se plig' reads stiff.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'in die eerste plek' is the fixed expression for primary responsibility; the meaning and the protected 'voeding' stay intact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The verb meaning 'entail' is the separable 'meebring'; bare 'bring' means 'carry/fetch'.
toegepas.fout: Bare 'bring' does not mean 'entail'; the verb is separable 'meebring'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'bring 'n verantwoordelikheid mee' is the correct verb for the meaning intended.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: two sentences with their own subject and verb joined by 'en' take a comma.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full sentences joined by 'en'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die onderwyser verduidelik' and 'more se werk bou' each have a subject and verb, so the comma is required.

toegepas.voor: Kinders gooi papier deur die klas en niemand
toegepas.na: Kinders gooi papier in die klas rond, en niemand
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'deur die klas gooi' can read as 'through the class'; 'in die klas rondgooi' is the idiom, and the comma follows AWS 2017 for two full sentences.
toegepas.fout: 'papier deur die klas gooi' can read as throwing paper through the class, and the AWS comma before 'en' is missing.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'in die klas rondgooi' is the idiom for the same action, and the comma is required between the two full sentences.

toegepas.blok: As 'n reg nie nagekom word nie
toegepas.voor: 'n Reg staan op papier en dit gebeur
toegepas.na: 'n Reg staan op papier, maar dit gebeur
toegepas.rede_vinder: The second clause contrasts with the first, so 'maar' fits, and two full sentences take a comma before the conjunction.
toegepas.fout: 'en' links two clauses that contrast, and the AWS comma is missing.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both clauses still say the same thing; 'maar' only makes the contrast that is already meant explicit, and the comma is required.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat die kinders onder meer gevra het
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'van geboorte af' is the fixed expression, and the list block already uses it.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'van sy geboorte af' is natural, correct Afrikaans; the proposal is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat die Grondwet onder meer vir elke kind gee
laat_vaar.voor: sorg by sy gesin, en gepaste ander sorg
laat_vaar.na: sorg by sy gesin en ander gepaste sorg
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: No comma before 'en' between two parts of one phrase (AWS 2017), and 'ander' naturally comes before the adjective 'gepaste'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The comma keeps the 'as hy daaruit weggeneem word' condition on the second item only, and 'gepaste ander sorg' (appropriate alternative care) would shift towards 'other appropriate care'.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'rondom jou' is the clearer, more natural way to say 'around you' here.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'kinders om jou' is natural Afrikaans; 'rondom jou' is only a different wording.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Afrikaans needs 'van' between 'lys' and what is in the list.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'die lys eise' is an accepted Afrikaans construction (like ''n lys name'), so this is no grammar error and glossary wording is not reworded for style.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'sê aan' reads first as 'tell to'; 'wys aan watter land' avoids the misreading.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'aan watter land ... behoort' is natural Afrikaans, and 'wys aan' would carry the same supposed misreading, so the proposal fixes nothing in a glossary entry.

laat_vaar.voor: of te help leef met iets
laat_vaar.na: of te help om saam te leef met iets
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'leef met' copies English 'live with'; Afrikaans says 'saamleef met', and 'help' then takes 'om te'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'leef met' is established Afrikaans in health contexts, and the proposal makes a glossary definition longer and clumsier.
'daarvan' refers to 'hulp', and 'hulp bring' is correct; the swap would also repeat 'lewer' from the next sentence in a glossary entry.

laat_vaar.voor: Ook organisasies wat die staat vir hierdie werk aangewys het, lewer hierdie dienste.
laat_vaar.na: Organisasies wat die staat vir hierdie werk aangewys het, lewer ook hierdie dienste.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Sentence-initial 'Ook' before a long subject reads wooden; 'ook' sits naturally after the verb.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Sentence-initial 'Ook' correctly puts the focus on organisations as well as workers; moving it shifts that focus to 'also these services' in a glossary entry.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'stukke' is vague for written documents; 'dokumente' says what is meant.
na_skrywer.fout: 'ander stukke' is vague for documents and a Grade 6 reader may read 'pieces'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: A possible real clarity fault, but it rewords a glossary definition, which only the writer may change.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: en so ook die grootmens wat weet en toelaat
na_skrywer.na: en so ook wanneer 'n grootmens weet en toelaat
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: As written the sentence says the adult IS abuse; 'wanneer' makes the adult's knowing and allowing the abuse, which is what is meant.
na_skrywer.fout: As written the sentence makes the adult who knows and allows it 'misbruik', instead of the knowing and allowing.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: A real fault in a legally loaded glossary definition; the writer must fix it, not a language agent.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.blok: Wat die handves nog verder sê
vlae.teks: Die handves vra verpligte skool wat gratis en gelyk is.
vlae.rede: 'gelyk' for a school is vague (equal for all children? equal quality?) and 'verpligte skool' is slightly odd for compulsory schooling; clarifying it would mean guessing what the charter demanded, so it is not changed here.
